title: Mayor Gloria Highlights Upcoming Speed Limit Reductions in San Ysidro
description: SAN DIEGO – Today Mayor Todd Gloria will joins City of San Diego Transportation Department crews in San Ysidro, where new speed limit signs are being installed as part of the City’s Comprehensive Speed Management Plan. Lower speed limits are coming to several neighborhoods across San Diego, and the sign installations begin this week in the San Ysidro and Otay Mesa communities.
